#!/usr/bin/env python3
import whisper
import json
import re

# Load the whisper model
print("Loading Whisper model...")
model = whisper.load_model("tiny")

# Transcribe with timestamps
print("Transcribing audio...")
result = model.transcribe("/root/tutorial_audio.wav", language="en", verbose=False)

# Save full transcription
with open("/root/full_transcription.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)

print("Transcription complete!")
print(f"Total segments: {len(result['segments'])}")

# Chapter keywords to search for
chapters = [
    ("What we'll do", ["what we'll do", "what we will do"]),
    ("How we'll get there", ["how we'll get there", "how we will get there"]),
    ("Getting a floor plan", ["getting a floor plan", "get a floor plan", "floor plan"]),
    ("Getting started", ["getting started", "get started"]),
    ("Basic Navigation", ["basic navigation", "navigation"]),
    ("Import your plan into Blender", ["import your plan", "import the plan", "import plan into blender"]),
    ("Basic transform operations", ["basic transform", "transform operations"]),
    ("Setting up the plan and units", ["setting up the plan", "set up the plan", "plan and units"]),
    ("It all starts with a plane", ["starts with a plane", "start with a plane"]),
    ("Scaling the plane to real dimensions", ["scaling the plane", "scale the plane", "real dimensions"]),
    ("Getting the plan in place", ["getting the plan in place", "get the plan in place", "plan in place"]),
    ("Tracing the outline", ["tracing the outline", "trace the outline"]),
    ("Tracing inner walls", ["tracing inner walls", "trace inner walls", "inner walls"]),
    ("Break", ["break", "take a break"]),
    ("Continue tracing inner walls", ["continue tracing", "continue with"]),
    ("Remove doubled vertices", ["remove doubled vertices", "doubled vertices", "remove doubles"]),
    ("Save", ["save", "let's save", "going to save"]),
    ("Make the floor", ["make the floor", "create the floor"]),
    ("Remove unnecessary geometry", ["remove unnecessary", "unnecessary geometry"]),
    ("Make the floor's faces", ["make the floor's faces", "floor's faces", "floor faces"]),
    ("Make the background", ["make the background", "create the background"]),
    ("Extruding the walls in Z", ["extruding the walls", "extrude the walls", "extrude in z"]),
    ("Reviewing face orientation", ["reviewing face orientation", "review face orientation", "face orientation"]),
    ("Adding thickness to walls with Modifiers", ["adding thickness", "thickness to walls", "modifier"]),
    ("Fixing face orientation errors", ["fixing face orientation", "fix face orientation"]),
    ("Note on face orientation", ["note on face orientation", "note about face"]),
    ("Save As", ["save as", "save the file as"]),
    ("If you need thick and thin walls", ["thick and thin walls", "thick thin walls"]),
    ("Great job!", ["great job", "good job", "congratulations"])
]

# Find timestamps
timestamps = []
for chapter_name, keywords in chapters:
    found = False
    for segment in result['segments']:
        text = segment['text'].lower()
        for keyword in keywords:
            if keyword in text:
                timestamps.append({
                    'chapter': chapter_name,
                    'timestamp': segment['start'],
                    'text': segment['text'].strip()
                })
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            break

    if not found:
        timestamps.append({
            'chapter': chapter_name,
            'timestamp': None,
            'text': 'NOT FOUND'
        })

# Print results
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("CHAPTER TIMESTAMPS")
print("="*80)
for i, ts in enumerate(timestamps, 1):
    if ts['timestamp'] is not None:
        print(f"{i:2d}. {ts['chapter']:45s} | {ts['timestamp']:7.1f}s | {ts['text'][:40]}")
    else:
        print(f"{i:2d}. {ts['chapter']:45s} | NOT FOUND")

# Save to file
with open("/root/chapter_timestamps.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(timestamps, f, indent=2)

print("\nResults saved to /root/chapter_timestamps.json")
